intro: When your space needs warmth without losing its sense of style, the Tactile Knit Collection steps in. Designed with textured knits that feel soft to the touch and look beautiful in any setting, these cushions turn sofas and beds into cozy corners you will keep coming back to.

features.title: High-quality zipper for smooth, lasting use
features.text: A cushion cover goes through far more wear and tear than it might seem — being unzipped, refilled, and washed again and again. This cover is fitted with a high-quality zipper built for that kind of smooth, repeated use, so it keeps opening and closing with ease and holds up well over time.

features.title: Combed cotton for an ultra-soft touch and feel
features.text: Run your hand over this cover, and the difference is immediately noticeable. Crafted with 100% combed cotton, it has a naturally soft, smooth texture that feels luxurious against the skin, whether it's styled on a sofa for lounging or a bed for a good night's rest.

features.title: Natural dyes for a more thoughtful everyday choice
features.text: A cushion cover sits close to you more often than most fabrics in the home, which is why how it's coloured matters. This cover is made using natural dyes, keeping exposure to harmful chemical residues to a minimum and making it a thoughtful choice for everyday use.

name: Fluorescent Green Grey Striped Knitted Cotton Cushion Cover
